claim_boundary: finite cubic-surface incidence theorem on the W33-derived E6 matter charts; it reconstructs the 120 Steiner trihedral-pair layer without claiming a continuum surface equation
reading: Each W33-derived E6 matter chart contains exactly 120 finite Steiner trihedral-pair witnesses. Each witness is a triple of double-sixes with pairwise overlap 6, empty triple intersection, and union size 18. The complementary 9 weights contain exactly six zero-sum tritangent triples, and those six split uniquely into a pair of trihedra. The incidence counts are sharp: every weight appears in 40 such pairs, every tritangent in 16, every double-six in 10, and every overlap-6 double-six pair in exactly one.
